texts.zh: 我们并不是在地表之下检测到了生命形式，事实上，是整个星球都检测到了生命！这颗冰封的星球内部布满了微细的管道，相互连接，就像一台原始的计算机。尽管结构很粗糙，它通天的规模意味着，其算力甚至可以匹敌[Owner.Capital.GetName]的某些超级计算机。即使是现在，这台电脑还在活动——我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]可以同其互动，但是由于它运转十分缓慢，我们只能询问其一个简单的问题。
texts.en: We didn't detect life forms below the surface. We detected them in the entire world! The frozen planet is interspersed with micro-thin tubes linked like a rudimentary computer. While the structure is primitive, its gigantic scale means it can probably rival some of [Owner.Capital.GetName]'s supercomputers in output. Even now, the computer seems to be active - our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] can interface with it, but since it's so slow, we would only be able to ask it a single question.

label.zh: 你能够解开这些计算吗？

label.en: Best to observe it from afar.
